title: Dropbox File Storage: Complete Architecture
description: Design dropbox file storage with monolith and microservice architectures using React, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and AWS.

data.text: Design a cloud file storage and synchronization system similar to Dropbox. Users store files in folders that sync across multiple devices, share folders with permissions, restore previous versions, and collaborate on documents. The system must handle large file uploads via chunking, detect changes with delta sync, and maintain consistency across offline clients.

data.title: Functional Requirements
items: Upload and download files up to 50GB with resumable chunked transfers
Synchronize files and folders across desktop, web, and mobile clients
Detect file changes using content-based hashing rather than timestamps
Maintain complete version history with rollback to any prior version
Share folders and files with view, edit, or comment permissions
Resolve sync conflicts when the same file is edited on multiple devices
Generate preview thumbnails for images, videos, PDFs, and documents
Show sync status (synced, syncing, error) and selective sync per device
Support shared links with password protection, expiration dates, and access logs
Search files by name, content, and metadata across all owned and shared items

data.title: Non-Functional Requirements
items: 99.99% durability for stored files with 11 nines of data integrity
Delta sync must detect changes under 100ms for files smaller than 10MB
Support 10 million concurrent active users with 500TB daily upload volume
End-to-end encryption for files at rest and in transit
Sub-second metadata API response for listing folders with 10,000 items
Offline-first sync with eventual consistency when devices reconnect

data.text: Start with a monolithic ASP.NET Core application that validates the Dropbox storage domain: file metadata, chunked uploads, version tracking, sharing permissions, and sync logic. This validates conflict resolution and delta detection before splitting into services.

data.title: Monolith Tech Stack
data.code:
Frontend:
  - React 18 with TypeScript
  - Vite for build tooling
  - Tailwind CSS for styling
  - React Query for server state

Backend (ASP.NET Core):
  - Minimal API or MVC Controllers
  - Entity Framework Core for data access
  - Azure SQL Database or AWS RDS for relational data
  - Built-in DI, logging, and health checks

Infrastructure:
  - Azure App Service or AWS EC2/ECS
  - Azure Blob Storage or AWS S3 for file assets
  - Azure Monitor or AWS CloudWatch for logging
  - Single database with tables for all domains

data.text: As traffic grows, split the monolith into independently scalable microservices. Each service owns its data and communicates via async messaging or REST/gRPC.

items: Upload Service: Handles multipart file uploads with chunk assembly, resumable transfers using presigned URLs, and duplicate detection via content hash. Returns a file handle once all chunks are committed.

Download Service: Serves file bytes with range request support for large files, generates short-lived presigned download URLs, and streams data directly from object storage without proxying through the API tier.

Sync Service: Detects file changes using content-based hashing, computes delta differences between versions, and pushes change notifications to connected clients. Manages sync cursors per device for offline reconciliation.
Metadata Service: Stores file and folder hierarchy, names, sizes, timestamps, and sharing permissions. Uses a graph-like structure for efficient tree traversal and path resolution.
Sharing Service: Manages shared links, collaborator invites, permission grants (viewer, editor, owner), and access audits. Enforces ACL checks on every file operation.
Version Service: Maintains immutable file versions with rollback support, tracks who modified each version, and applies retention policies to purge old versions beyond the user quota.

data.title: React App Structure
data.code:
src/
  features/
    DropboxStorage/
      components/
        FileBrowser/          # Grid/list view with breadcrumb navigation
        UploadProgress/       # Chunked upload progress bar with pause/resume
        SyncStatusIndicator/  # Synced / syncing / error state per file
        VersionHistory/       # Timeline of file versions with preview
        SharingModal/         # Invite users, copy link, set permissions
        ConflictResolution/   # Side-by-side diff when same file edited on two devices
        FilePreview/          # Inline preview for images, PDFs, videos
      hooks/
        useFileSync/          # Sync cursor management and delta polling
        useChunkedUpload/     # AbortController-based chunk upload with retry
        useFileSearch/        # Debounced search across owned and shared files
      api/
        files.ts              # GET /files/metadata, POST /files/upload-chunk
        sync.ts               # GET /sync/changes?cursor=, POST /sync/commit
        sharing.ts            # POST /sharing/share, DELETE /sharing/:id
        versions.ts           # GET /files/:id/versions, POST /files/:id/restore
      store/
        fileStore.ts          # Current folder path, file tree, selected files
        syncStore.ts          # Sync cursor, pending uploads, conflict queue

Key Patterns:
  - Feature-based folder structure
  - API Gateway as single entry point
  - React Query for metadata caching
  - Web Workers for large file hash computation (SHA-256)
  - Service Worker cache for offline file listing access
